notes.title: Hargrave 2-Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
Today marks the two year anniversary of the release of Hargrave, an adventure that I dreamed of creating for a long time. I give great thanks to everyone who has given it a try, and am glad for all the praise and criticism that has helped me shape the game for the better.

It's an honor to be able to share news of the future here, and so here it goes! Hargrave 2 is officially in development, and it is now my great ambition to create a sequel that is a worthy successor to the original. It may be a long journey before this project is complete, but I hope you will consider checking back in a year or two for updates along the way. During this time I may have some fun side projects to share, which will likely also be set in the Hargrave universe.

Thank you again,

Disafter

notes.title: Update 11/22/2020
notes.notes:
-As always, collect all 69 Power Cells to unlock the Grave entrance from your Warp Hub
-Take on the Grave Sector 6, the toughest zone yet! Don't forget to bring your cube!

notes.title: Update 10/28/2020
notes.notes:
-Collect all 69 Power Cells to unlock the Grave entrance from your Warp Hub
-Take on the exceptionally difficult Grave Sector 5 and push your platforming skills to the limit!

notes.title: Update 10/23/2020
notes.notes:
-Collect all 69 Power Cells to unlock the Grave entrance from your Warp Hub
-These sectors contain exceptional difficulty - only the bravest dare enter!
-Take on the first four Grave Sectors and defeat the powered up Grave-difficulty boss waiting at the end

notes.title: Update 10/18/2020
notes.notes:
-Collect all 69 Power Cells to unlock the Grave entrance from your Warp Hub
-Grave Sectors contain more difficult platforming and a battle against an enhanced version of the corresponding sector's boss!

notes.title: Update 10/16/2020
notes.notes:
-The game now allows you to have up to 3 save files
-A number of rooms have been updated or improved
